title: Collect answers from people
blurb: A page with your questions on it. Every answer is saved in a spreadsheet you can open in Excel.
best_for: Sign-ups, feedback, a survey, orders, a waiting list, a class list.

asks.label: What should this be called?
asks.help: Only you see this: it is the name of the folder and the browser tab.

asks.label: The question at the top of the page
asks.placeholder: Coming on the trip? Tell me here.
asks.default: Please fill this in — it takes a minute.

asks.label: What do you want to ask people?
default: Anything you would like me to know?
asks.help: One question per line. You can change these later by editing questions.txt.

changing: The questions are lines in questions.txt - open it in Notepad or TextEdit, change the lines, save, and refresh the page.
The big question at the top of the page is in web/index.html.
Every answer is saved in data/answers.csv. Open it in Excel, Numbers or Google Sheets whenever you like - it is an ordinary spreadsheet.
Remember to say yes if Excel asks about importing a CSV file; the answers are separated by commas.

map.run.bat: double-click to start it on Windows
map.run.sh: double-click to start it on macOS or Linux
map.questions.txt: your questions, one per line - edit this freely
map.start.py: the small program that serves the form
map.serve.py: the engine (you never need to open this)
map.web/index.html: the words on the form page
map.data/: everything people have sent you lives in here
